records.title: Oposición a la propuesta de liquidación de intereses de Construcciones Acosta Matos, S.A.
records.principal_filename: oposicion a la propuesta de liquidacion de intereses.pdf
records.annex_filename: Deuda Hipotecaria - 31 de Mayo 2018 - Listado Fincas _1_.pdf
records.verified_proposition: LPB opposed CAM's 18 May interest-liquidation proposal and argued that privileged interest had to be determined within the approved liquidation-plan framework, with ultimate judicial determination in case of dispute.
records.proof_limit: The receipt proves the filing, annex and asserted position. It does not prove that CAM's calculation was false or that LPB's legal position was correct.
records.linked_response: A court Auto dated 4 June was notified through LexNET on 7 June; the repository treats the operative judicial position as materially adverse on the relevant interest/implementation questions.
records.source: Connected Gmail LexNET receipt re-verified 29 Aug 2026
